content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the STPINEXT Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of STPINEXT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for STPINEXT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the STPINEXT Finance Executive and Administration Executive posts is 21st August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Finance Executive and Administration Executive posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the STPINEXT Recruitment 2026. One vacancy is for the Finance Executive post and another for the Administration Executive post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Finance Executive?
faq.answer: For the Finance Executive position, candidates must be a Graduate from a recognized university. A Post-Graduation in Commerce or MBA (Finance) or equivalent is desirable. The role also requires 3 years of experience in Finance and Accountancy.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Administration Executive post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Administration Executive post is 42 years. Age relaxation may be permissible for deserving candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Finance Executive role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Finance Executive position will receive a consolidated salary of ₹ 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for STPINEXT Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for STPINEXT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the information available, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Finance Executive and Administration Executive are offered on a contract basis under STPINEXT Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for STPINEXT Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the experience required for the Administration Executive post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Administration Executive post must have a minimum of 5 years of work experience in the relevant field. A graduate degree is the basic educational requirement.
